$comment: Hand-maintained manifest metadata for the zone-v1 contract kinds.
contracts/tools/sync_vendor.py merges this with computed schema digests
into zone-v1.manifest.gen.json; digests are never hand-written.

auth.sudo.dev/v1.data_classification: zone metadata and authorization facts; no user content, no secrets

common.sudo.dev/v1.data_classification: resource identity references; no payload bytes, no secrets

amendments.note: ZoneGrant is a revocable business fact, not a ReBAC tuple/API-key junction/token claim; those are projections with source_grant_id provenance. ZoneOperation carries an inline ErrorInfo because the A2 file list has no standalone error-info schema; if one is ever added, move the definition and keep the wire shape identical.
